subject.title: feat(browser): send pages to OpenClaw from the Chrome extension

question: Should OpenClaw ship page sharing as a bundled Chrome-extension capability with an additive public plugin-SDK resolver once the default lazy Gateway lifecycle is repaired and proven?
rationale: The mechanical lifecycle repair is narrow, but accepting a new bundled browser-to-agent ingress feature and public plugin-SDK surface is a durable product and ownership decision.

options.title: Sponsor the integrated feature
options.body: Repair sink registration in the lazy Gateway path, prove the normal pairing flow, and accept the narrowly documented SDK addition.

options.title: Keep the browser relay transport-only
options.body: Pause this integrated feature and pursue any future page-share capability through a separately approved plugin or SDK design.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the integrated feature
recommendation.body: Repair sink registration in the lazy Gateway path, prove the normal pairing flow, and accept the narrowly documented SDK addition.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the proposed browser relay design and current feature branch, so they are the best available routing candidate for the implementation and design context.
